segments.on_screen_text: FINDING COMFORT soft summer days on the island
segments.description: Intro montage featuring scenic clips from the island trip.
Taking the bus, buying ferry tickets, and boarding the ferry.
Walking through Sidney, visiting local shops and waterfront.

segments.on_screen_text: by late afternoon we made our way into victoria
segments.description: Taking bus to Victoria, strolling streets, Chinatown, and eating ramen/bao.

segments.on_screen_text: the next day was slower softer
segments.description: Visiting Fisherman's Wharf, eating fish and chips and chowder.

segments.on_screen_text: we found a retro little coffee shop
segments.description: Coffee break at Routine Coffee & Supply and browsing gift shops.

segments.on_screen_text: later a stop at the bakery gave us a little pick me up
segments.description: Visiting a bakery and exploring a bookstore.
Thrifting at Upcycle Clothing Collective and visiting Paboom gift shop.
Ferry ride back during sunset and concluding thoughts.

hook.opening_visual: Sunset view on a ferry deck with people sitting at tables.
hook.notes: Starts with an aesthetic montage previewing the island trip with music.
